# 2 Humanoid Robot ETFs Now Trading as AI Boom Expands
- HUMN joins KOID in targeting humanoid robot stocks.

[HUMN](https://www.etf.com/HUMN)-5.53%

The [**Roundhill Humanoid Robotics ETF (HUMN)**](https://www.etf.com/humn) began trading today, coming just three weeks after the launch of the [**KraneShares Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index ETF (KOID)**](https://www.etf.com/koid).

## KOID vs. HUMN
KOID tracks the MerQube Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index and currently has around $3.2 million in assets under management. The ETF holds 51 equally weighted stocks, ranging from large-cap names like [Nvidia Corp. (NVDA)](https://www.etf.com/stock/NVDA) and [Tesla Inc. (TSLA)](https://www.etf.com/stock/tsla), to smaller players such as [MP Materials Corp. (MP)](https://www.etf.com/stock/MP) and Melexis NV.
